snip.t: *Answer*: Intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) – it is easier to administer, has comparable efficacy to plasma exchange, and avoids central line complications.
The prognosis is usually poor; however, some patients have responded to steroids and intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG).
Often when no pathogens are identified and a postinfectious or autoimmune etiology is suspected, patients are treated with a combination of steroids, intravenous immunoglobulin, and plasmapheresis
